tagline: Cross-platform mobile apps in React Native & Flutter across language learning, healthcare, and transport.
description:
• Built cross-platform mobile apps in React Native and Flutter across language learning, healthcare, and transportation.
• Designed scalable, reusable UI components leveraging Material UI principles and mobile design systems.
• Integrated frontends with RESTful APIs and PostgreSQL backends for smooth data handling and reliable performance.
• Drove performance optimizations (lazy loading, efficient state management with Redux/Provider), reducing load times and improving responsiveness.
• Implemented secure flows including Stripe payments, OTP verification, and encrypted real-time messaging.
• Released apps to the Apple App Store and Google Play, ensuring compliance with platform standards.
• Applied analytics insights to resolve UX pain points, driving measurable engagement gains.

tagline: Scalable web & mobile apps with React, React Native, and Node.js — including the BeautyPass lifestyle app.
description:
• Built scalable web and mobile apps using React Native, React, and Node.js — achieving a 40% performance boost and 30% engagement increase.
• Developed state-managed UI (Redux, Zustand) for maintainable, testable, scalable codebases.
• Implemented server-side rendering (SSR) and SEO optimizations for web platforms.
• Collaborated in Agile teams, integrating .NET APIs with cross-platform UIs at 95% on-time delivery.
• Set up Dockerized environments and CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, streamlining deployments.
• Worked from Figma handoffs, adhering to brand and accessibility standards.
• Contributed to BeautyPass, a high-profile lifestyle app, delivering React Native features for the influencer and fashion industry.

tagline: Responsive React apps backed by automated Cypress test suites and performance audits.
description:
• Built and tested responsive React applications, ensuring accessibility and cross-device compatibility.
• Developed automated test suites (Cypress), reducing manual QA by 50% and increasing release confidence.
• Conducted usability testing and performance audits, improving UI responsiveness by up to 60%.
• Accelerated release cycles with end-to-end and regression testing pipelines, cutting QA overhead by 40%.

tagline: Mobile-first React Native & Flutter apps with offline-first architecture and optimized state management.
description:
• Developed React Native and Flutter apps for mobile-first projects, improving UX by 35% with responsive, consistent design systems.
• Refactored and modularized UI components, reducing bundle size by 50% and improving maintainability.
• Integrated REST & GraphQL APIs with optimized state management (Redux, React Query, Provider), reducing latency by 20%.
• Built offline-first features in React Native, ensuring uninterrupted access to critical data in low-connectivity scenarios.
